metaDescription: CPT 99437 explained: the add-on to 99491 for each additional 30 minutes of physician time in CCM. Pairing rules, documentation and 2026 rate.
summary: An add-on reported with 99491 for each additional 30 minutes the practitioner personally spends on care management that month.
time: Each additional 30 minutes of practitioner time
performer: The physician or other qualified practitioner personally
requirements: 99491 supported for the same patient and month
Practitioner time log showing minutes beyond the first 30
Consent and care plan documentation in place
pitfalls: Adding staff minutes to the practitioner's total

faqs.question: Can 99437 be billed without 99491?
faqs.answer: No. It is an add-on to 99491 and cannot stand alone.

faqs.question: Do staff minutes count toward 99437?
faqs.answer: No. Only the practitioner's own time counts.
